t: What one day of fasting is measured against
a: مَنْ صَامَ يَوْمًا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى بَاعَدَ اللَّهُ وَجْهَهُ عَنِ النَّارِ سَبْعِينَ خَرِيفًا
p: Man ṣāma yawman fī sabīli-Llāhi tabāraka wa taʿālā bāʿada-Llāhu wajhahu ʿani-n-nāri sabʿīna kharīfā
m: Whoever fasts one day in the path of Allah, Allah puts seventy autumns between his face and the Fire.
